articles.title: Rupee nears record low despite RBI hike, governor says markets can be irrational
articles.excerpt:
The Indian rupee has dipped to its lowest point in five months, following a recent interest rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India. Analysts remark that the monetary policy appears too lenient to stabilize the currency. Investors are wary as ongoing portfolio outflows and rising global bond yields continue to exert pressure.

articles.title: Rupee undervalued, RBI governor says, even as he promises stability against dollar
articles.excerpt:
The rupee may be “undervalued” as per many estimates, Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said on Wednesday, and assured that the banking regulator will support the currency to reach its “correct value”.

Speaking to reporters on a day that saw the rupee inch towards an all-time low against the dollar, Malhotra said that while markets can be “irrational” in the short term, they reflect their right value in the long run.

articles.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares rise 2% as HSBC upgrades stock to buy
articles.excerpt:
FILE PHOTO: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares rose 2 per cent after HSBC upgraded the stock to Buy and raised its target price to ₹520 from ₹430. | Photo Credit: ADNAN ABIDI

Shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 2 per cent in Wednesday’s session amid sectoral developments, including the RBI repo rate hike. The stock hit an intraday high of ₹440.70 on the NSE, compared with the previous close of ₹431.90. At 12.37 pm, it traded at ₹439.40.

HSBC upgraded Kotak Mahindra Bank to Buy and raised its target price to ₹520 from ₹430 earlier. HSBC turned constructive on the stock following the recent CEO appointment and a stronger loan and EPS growth outlook.
